source_behavior_notes: Actual default optimal.adj grid has seven rho values;the manual describes eight.
Missing ratio and MAF cutoff comparisons in source are strict less-than.
One-variant or equal-column sets can switch SKAT-O to SKAT.
Source test.snp.mac is a column sum of processed Z;it must not be minorized a second time.
runtime_scope: Exact R/package versions and all239 SKAT function formals/bodies are checked;native/runtime files are fingerprinted before fitting and rechecked after. These are integrity/source checks,not producer or full native-code authentication.
